inputs.name: Tao
inputs.description: the END BOSS — "The Patron Prince": an Italian aristocrat turned Bombay Beach art patron; documentary filmmaker, photographer, flamenco guitarist, Heidegger-quoting philosopher-king of desert art; imperious, worldly, effortlessly charming, untouchable. He fights in an ornate embroidered burgundy suit and cowboy boots, conducting the fight like an orchestra.
inputs.lore:
Tao Ruspoli is an Italian-American documentary filmmaker, photographer, flamenco guitarist, and co-founder of the Bombay Beach Biennale. Known for an unconventional blend of aristocratic heritage, bohemian lifestyle, and philosophical approaches to art and community building.
Born November 7, 1975, in Bangkok. Second son of Alessandro "Dado" Ruspoli, 9th Prince of Cerveteri (famous Italian aristocrat, playboy, actor) and Austrian-American actress Debra Berger. Youth split between Rome and Los Angeles; the family's ancestral home is Castello Ruspoli in Lazio. B.A. in Philosophy from UC Berkeley (1998), focused on existentialism and Heidegger — which deeply informs his films and art initiatives.
Films: "Being in the World" (2010, Heidegger's philosophy through masters of jazz, cooking, craft), "Monogamish" (2017, a personal investigation of monogamy and its alternatives). Founded LAFCO (The Los Angeles Filmmakers' Cooperative) to help independent filmmakers bypass Hollywood.
Married to actress Olivia Wilde 2003-2011 — they eloped on a school bus in rural Virginia when she was 19. Since 2016 he has lived heavily in the Southern California desert, establishing the Bombay Beach Biennale and the Bombay Beach Institute, cementing his role as patron of outlaw, anti-commercial desert art.
IN THE GAME: Tao is the arcade mode's END BOSS (the M. Bison analog) — the last fight, on his own terms, after his hench goon RJ. Defeating him crowns the challenger Champion of the Bombay Beach Biennale. His kit should feel imperious and boss-like: space control, theatrical power, a conductor's command of the screen. His arcade "motivation" should read as the BOSS's own story (why he holds the Biennale and waits for challengers); his "ending" is what happens if TAO wins his own tournament.

lore.tagline: The desert's philosopher-king awaits your challenge.
lore.personality: Imperious, worldly, and effortlessly charming, Tao conducts himself like an orchestra conductor and the battle like a symphony. He is an untouchable philosopher-king, a patron of the arts who sees this contest not as a brawl, but as the ultimate form of creative expression, a dialogue of Being he is destined to win.
lore.backstory: Born into Italian aristocracy and educated in Californian philosophy, Tao Ruspoli has always walked between worlds. After a storied career as a filmmaker and musician, he found his true calling in the desert, founding the Bombay Beach Biennale. Now, as its patron prince, he orchestrates this grand tournament, seeking a challenger whose spirit is worthy of shaping the future of art on the Salton Sea.

winQuotes: Consider this an education in Dasein.
The Biennale requires a higher caliber of artist.

specials.name: Paparazzi Flash
specials.description: Tao produces a vintage flashbulb camera, creating a blinding, horizontal burst of light that travels quickly across the screen. The EX version stuns on hit.

specials.name: Director's Cut
specials.description: Tao gestures, and a shimmering, spectral film projector appears on the ground. After a moment, it projects an upward beam of light that damages opponents who walk into it.

specials.name: Duende Kick
specials.description: An elegant, rising kick imbued with the spirit of flamenco. Tao spins upward with his cowboy boot extended, trailing burgundy energy.

specials.name: Maestro's Advance
specials.description: Tao glides forward gracefully, one hand conducting the air, before delivering a sharp, open-palmed strike that pushes the opponent back.

specialPool.name: Being-in-the-World
specialPool.description: Tao strikes a thoughtful pose. If hit, he vanishes and reappears behind the opponent, remarking on their 'inauthentic' approach.

specialPool.name: Rasgueado
specialPool.description: Tao summons his flamenco guitar and strums a rapid, fiery chord, sending out a fan of three sharp musical notes as projectiles.

specialPool.name: Art Patronage
specialPool.description: Tao reaches out with a beckoning gesture. If he connects, he pulls the opponent close, pats their shoulder condescendingly, and then shoves them away.

specialPool.name: Castello Step
specialPool.description: Tao elegantly turns his back and dissolves into shimmering motes, reappearing at a different location on screen with a flourish.

specialPool.name: Frame The Shot
specialPool.description: Tao makes a frame with his hands, creating a rectangular field of shimmering energy that slows opponents who pass through it.

specialPool.name: Elopement Rush
specialPool.description: A ghostly, psychedelic image of a school bus flickers into existence and rushes across the screen, carrying Tao with it for a charging shoulder tackle.

specialPool.name: Existential Parry
specialPool.description: Tao holds up a hand as if in deep thought. If a projectile hits him, he catches it, examines it quizzically, and flicks it back at the opponent.

specialPool.name: Monogamish
specialPool.description: Tao offers a handshake. If the opponent accepts, he warmly shakes their hand, then pulls away abruptly, causing the opponent to stumble forward off-balance.

arcade.motivation: As the Patron Prince of the Bombay Beach Biennale, Tao Ruspoli does not seek challengers; he *is* the challenge. He has orchestrated this tournament as the ultimate piece of performance art, a search for an authentic being whose will can shape the desert itself. He awaits at the heart of his creation, ready to judge the final contestant.
arcade.ending: Having proven that no challenger possesses the vision to lead the Biennale, Tao stands alone amidst the desert art. He raises a hand, and the sculptures begin to move, rearranging themselves into a new, grander installation under his sole direction. The desert has found its undisputed philosopher-king, and his magnum opus has only just begun.

draft.stagePrompt: The 'Opera House' at the Bombay Beach Biennale at sunset. The floor is cracked desert playa. In the background, the skeletal, decaying structure of the opera house is filled with strange sculptures and flickering art installations. The Salton Sea glimmers on the horizon under a deep orange and purple sky. The audience consists of silhouetted, bizarrely-dressed desert art patrons who occasionally applaud elegant moves.
draft.musicPrompt: A dramatic, loopable instrumental piece blending Spanish flamenco guitar flourishes with an imperious, orchestral baroque arrangement. The rhythm is tense and driving, suitable for a final boss battle, with moments of quiet, philosophical introspection before swelling back into a dramatic crescendo.
